thread:
maya: Heads-up: prod embeddings spiking 503s at 08:12. Recent worker-image bump looks like it increased memory usage in eu-west and some pods are getting killed. I opened a tiny hotfix PR to pin the image and reduce per-worker queue depth. Need expedited deploy. @ops-oncall can you triage and sign off?

deploybot: New deploy request created: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4832 (hotfix/embed-pin-queue). Suggested rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 30% -> 100%. Requires two approvals OR explicit ops-oncall fast-track to bypass waiting window.

igor: What's the exact rollback instructions if this regresses? We should keep the old image tag handy.

maya: Rollback plan: revert to image sha-abc123 and scale replicas to 12. No DB changes. Commands: 
```
# deploybot rollback
deploybot rollback --service embeddings --to-image sha-abc123
# or kubectl
kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=sha-abc123 -n prod
```
Smoke checks: /health 200, no OOM logs, queue length stable under 100.

sam: I'd like at least the 1% canary. If ops sees green for 5m we can jump to 30%. Ops approval can accelerate beyond the standard 2-approver requirement.

liz: I'll prep a short release note blurb: "Hotfix: pin embed worker image + queue tuning to reduce 503 spikes." Will link PR.

ops-oncall: Can do expedited signoff after 1% smoke. I'll run synthetic checks and tail the pod logs. If canary shows no OOMs and 5xx drops, I'll OK jump to 30%.

deploybot: Canary starting: 1% traffic (approx 28 pods). Status: canary deploy in progress.

maya: Canary looks clean so far, patched pods stable, 5xx down ~80% on the canary slice. No OOMs in logs.

igor: Dashboards confirm error rate down and latency same or slightly improved. +1 to accelerate but keep a 5 minute observe between steps.

deploybot: Promoted 1% -> 5%. 5% rollout succeeded.

sam: Ready to push further once ops gives go.

ops-oncall: Go to 30%. We'll monitor for 10m and will rollback if 5xx exceeds 2x baseline or any OOMs.

deploybot: Promoted 5% -> 30%. 30% rollout completed.

maya: Logs still clean. Request full rollout to fully mitigate customer impact.

igor: Fine by me, ops has final GO.

ops-oncall: Approving full rollout. I'll keep an eye for 15m. Rollback threshold: sustained 5xx > 2x baseline or pod OOMs x3.

deploybot: Promoted 30% -> 100%. Deploy finished at 1755564200.

maya: Thanks team 1 incident mitigated. Release note posted and PR linked: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/4832. If anything odd crops up I'll reopen thread.
